title: Nourishing Ethiopian Lentil Gratin
description: A hearty, crowd-pleasing Ethiopian dish featuring mustardy flavors and fromage frais, with an al-dente finish, served in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil and add the lentils, reducing heat to a simmer.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mustard seeds to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir the fromage frais into the skillet and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked lentils, salt-free seasoning blend, and skillet mixture to a large bowl and stir to combine.
Divide the lentil mixture among individual mini cocottes.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and set.
